name: Venlafaxine
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Hepatic CYP2D6 O-demethylation produces active O-desmethylvenlafaxine (desvenlafaxine). Other demethylation/conjugation routes also occur. Elimination is mainly urinary as parent and metabolites.
